FleetTask.description: One row per ledger entry a developer's fleet has in flight — the grid's live view of _fleet/local/LEDGER.md, projected up before any commit exists.

ActorPresence.description: One row per developer per repo — is their fleet running right now, on which branch, since when. `ended_at` (G3.5, additive) is set on a run_end supersession — the row is never deleted, only re-ingested with `ended_at` populated; a bare SELECT * still returns every version ever ingested (verified — RelataDB has no server-side dedup), so materialize()'s last-write-wins resolution (G3.4) sees the ended state without any row ever being removed.

HandoffPointer.description: A pointer to (and a digest of) one handoff file — never the handoff body, never file contents. Server-side cell ACL is not fully wired, so a minimal payload is the defense.

RunEventSummary.description: Per-actor, per-run counts reduced from _fleet/local/runs/<actor>-<ts>/events.jsonl — the run event vocabulary from src/compile/telemetry.js, never the raw event stream itself.

OrgDocument.description: One row per chunk of an imported meeting note, discussion, decision record, or spec (G6.1) — provenance-tracked org knowledge, keyed by content hash so a re-import of unchanged content is a local no-op (RelataDB itself has no server-side dedup on /ingest — see FleetTask's own note — so idempotency here is a client-side digest-tracking concern, the same shape as G3.2's pushed.json). `valid_from` is the document's own business date (the meeting date, not the import date) — a plain data field, not an engine-level bi-temporal parameter; the engine's own system-time versioning is separate and not client-settable. `_emb_text` (G6.2, optional) carries the chunk's own text again for the engine/customer-run embedder sidecar to embed on ingest — present only when the sidecar is configured (`RELATA_ACCEL_ENDPOINT`/`accelEndpoint`); recall degrades to BM25 full-text ranking when it is absent.
